newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian bourse index slips in brisk trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian bourse index slips in brisk trade.

text.p: The Estonian bourse slipped slightly on Monday in a relatively brisk day of trade, dealers said.
The index fell by 0.12 percent to 108.87 points and the overall market volume was 10 million kroons.
Market leader Hansa Bank was the most active listing in trade of 5.3 million kroons and it closed up at 108.10 kroons compared with 107.80 kroons on Friday.
Volume on the secondary list was 2.8 million kroons.
